name: alörn
note: Lill Alörn; Stor Alörn is a separate entry.

name: brunnen vid klockstapeln
note: Well east of the church, where the well house was built in the early 1840s.

name: döbelnmonumentet vid juthas
note: Monument to G. C. von Döbeln at the Juthas battlefield, about 3 km outside the town.

name: karleborgsgatan
note: Called Carlborgsgatan on Kjellman's town plan from 1842.

name: riksväg åtta
note: Highway passing by Nykarleby. The geocoded point was near Vaasa.

name: scholan
note: School house from 1729, the south wing of the town hall.

name: storbron
note: The bridge by the church; burned 1808, rebuilt 1817.

name: torpet vid repslagarbanan
note: Croft near today's children's home, on Holm's map 1806.

name: tullhuset
note: The northern customs house at Norrtull, now Nykarleby museum.
